title: Internally and externally induced chiral hybrid metal halide materials for advanced chiroptoelectronic applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01258A, Review Article
Puxin Cheng, Yue Wang, Peihan Wang, Mingyang Xin, Dahui Hu, Mengyu Liu, Yongshen Zheng, Jialiang Xu
Chiral hybrid metal halides comprise tunable chiral structures with remarkable optoelectronic characteristics, offering new avenues for synergistically manipulating the optical, electrical, and magnetic physical degrees of freedom.
